proposed_comments.title: Validate bounded ZoomIt settings before writing

confidence.rationale: The converged fork review required explicit range checks for RecordScaling, nested hotkey codes, and the exposed ZoomIt slider and enum controls before interop writes.

proposed_comments.body:
### Validate bounded ZoomIt settings before writing

**Severity:** `high`

`SetState` forwards the requested values directly to the native interop. The current UI and native code impose bounds that this DSC path does not enforce: `RecordScaling` must be 10–100, nested hotkey `value.code` must be 0–255, and the exposed sliders/enums must stay within their UI/native ranges. Reject invalid values before the first interop write and add boundary tests so a hand-authored DSC document cannot persist values that underflow, corrupt packed hotkeys, or produce invalid ZoomIt behavior.

proposed_comments.title: Reject unknown recording formats

confidence.rationale: The current native branch maps every value other than GIF to MP4, so malformed input is silently accepted and persisted as a different format.

proposed_comments.body:
### Reject unknown recording formats

**Severity:** `high`

This conversion treats every value other than `GIF` as `MP4`. A malformed `RecordFormat` therefore silently changes the requested state instead of failing validation. Accept only the supported `GIF` and `MP4` values and return an invalid-argument error for anything else before updating the registry-backed state.

proposed_comments.title: Exercise native rejection paths

confidence.rationale: The added tests replace the native save delegate with an in-memory function; they do not execute the native invalid-format, string-size, or binary-size rejection branches.

proposed_comments.body:
### Exercise native rejection paths

**Severity:** `medium`

The new tests validate the managed DSC wrapper and only read through the real interop. Save tests replace `SaveSettingsJson` with an in-memory delegate, so they cannot catch regressions in the native invalid-format, string-length, or binary-size rejection paths added by this change. Add focused native/interoperability coverage that invokes `SaveSettingsJson` with each malformed input and verifies rejection without mutating the registry.

proposed_comments.title: Fix the StyleCop blank-line violation

confidence.rationale: The exact upstream DSC build fails with SA1515 at this newly added comment; inserting the required blank line is a deterministic build fix.

proposed_comments.body:
### Fix the StyleCop blank-line violation

**Severity:** `low`

The exact upstream DSC build reports `SA1515` on this comment because it follows the `Workspaces` registration without a separating blank line. Add the required blank line before the ZoomIt comment and rerun the DSC build.
